notes.title: Cascadence Patch 1.0.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello! This update for Cascadence comes a few balance changes and auto-save!

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Auto-saving: Save those F5 presses and trips to the save menu out of concern for pending crashes, Cascadence now has auto-saving! Auto-save is enabled by default but if you prefer to be in control of your own destiny you can disable it anytime in the save menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45054963/186ab27d2d9e7d5195bbdf0d259f76ff7b2b9e6f.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Grey resource containers (containers closest to spawn) now have higher minimum resources
[*]In an effort to give the player more options early game and boost resources the following upgrades have small reductions in cost:
[list]
[*]Radar
[*]Sprint
[*]Pistol ammo capacity
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Beta patch 0.0.2.1
notes.notes:
Updates:
[list]
[*] Increase plasma rocket cooldown by 1 second
[*] Various improvements to sounds (enemies, turrets, etc)
[*] Adjustments to game soundtrack durations
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed animations on enemy spawn location icon pings sometimes playing incorrectly
[/list]

notes.title: Beta patch 0.0.2.0
notes.notes:
Updates:
[list]
[*]Enemies now spawn in clusters of specific map regions rather than spawning evenly across all spawn points in the map
[*]In-world icons have been added at the locations of active spawn clusters (see above) to indicate where enemies will likely spawn the next night
[*]Rifle recoil reduced
[*]Turret firing rate increased
[*]Reduced size of refiners
[*]Slight increase to daily resource drop at the end of night
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Improvements to enemy pathfinding, specifically when chasing player
[*]Fixed bug that caused songs to end early during the daytime
[*]Fixed bug that caused next song to not queue after previous song ended during the daytime
[*]Improved resource GUI background size/positioning during animations
[*]Fixed bug that caused icons to be misplaced on build-bar
[/list]

notes.title: Beta patch 0.0.1.1
notes.notes:
This patch includes some changes mostly to balance/difficulty:

Updates:
[list]
[*]Boxes now contain more resources
[*]Boxes now have a higher chance of containing health
[*]Health is now cheaper to acquire from the upgrade menu
[/list]

notes.title: Beta patch 0.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Thanks to the hard work of diligent testers this patch includes a fix for the strategy affectionately known as "Build a bunch of refiners at the end of the night to major profits

Updates:
[list]
[*]Refiners no longer give resources if built at night, they must be active for a full day/night cycle
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed weapon disappearing when firing Plasma Rocket while reloading another weapon
[*]Fixed still being able to shoot weapon even while dead
[/list]
